title: SQL Injection vulnerability in user search endpoint
description: User search query parameter 'q' is concatenated directly into SQL statement: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%'+q+'%' allowing unauthorized extraction of password hashes.

title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting in profile bio input
description: The profile bio field reflects unescaped user input inside the HTML page. Payload <script>alert(document.cookie)</script> executes in victim browser context.

title: Broken Object Level Authorization allows invoice access
description: Changing invoice_id in GET /api/v1/invoices/{id} allows regular users to view invoices belonging to other organizations without authorization checks.

title: Hardcoded JWT secret key allows token forgery
description: Found hardcoded secret string 'supersecretkey123' in authentication service. Attackers can forge valid admin tokens and bypass all authorization.

title: Insecure file upload permits arbitrary PHP execution
description: Profile avatar upload endpoint does not validate file extensions or MIME types. Uploading shell.php allows remote code execution on the web server.

title: Sensitive payment card numbers logged in plaintext
description: Application server logs credit card numbers and CVV codes in /var/log/app/transactions.log when payment gateway requests fail.

title: Missing rate limiting on login endpoint enables credential stuffing
description: The POST /auth/login route lacks rate limiting or captcha, permitting automated brute-force attacks against user credentials.

title: Directory traversal in report download endpoint
description: The parameter filename=../../../../etc/passwd allows unauthorized retrieval of arbitrary system files from the underlying operating system.

title: CORS misconfiguration allows arbitrary origin reflection
description: Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is set to reflect any Origin request header with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true, leaking user data.

title: Session token not invalidated upon user logout
description: Session ID remains active and reusable on the server after the user clicks logout, allowing session hijacking via retained cookies.

title: IDOR vulnerability in password reset confirmation
description: Password reset token endpoint does not bind token to user ID, allowing resetting any account password by swapping parameter target_user.

title: Command injection in diagnostic ping tool
description: The network diagnostic utility passes user IP input directly to system command 'ping -c 4 ' + host without sanitization or shell escaping.

title: Null pointer exception when processing empty cart checkout
description: Clicking checkout button with an empty session cart triggers an unhandled NullPointerException in CheckoutService.java:142 causing 500 error.

title: Discount voucher applied twice during multi-tab checkout
description: Opening checkout in two browser tabs allows applying the single-use promotion coupon twice, resulting in a negative total amount.

title: Off-by-one error in pagination calculation on dashboard
description: When viewing the last page of customer records, the total count displays 21 items but only 20 are rendered, skipping the final record.

title: Incorrect currency conversion rounding leads to undercharging
description: Currency conversion formula truncates floating point values instead of rounding to two decimal places, losing pennies on EUR to USD conversions.

title: Order status transitions to Delivered before shipment dispatch
description: Database trigger automatically marks order status as 'DELIVERED' upon warehouse packaging completion rather than awaiting courier webhook.

title: Duplicate user registration permitted when emails differ by case
description: System does not normalize email to lowercase before unique check, allowing john@example.com and JOHN@example.com to register distinct accounts.

title: Inventory stock count decrements below zero on concurrent purchases
description: Simultaneous purchases of the last inventory item allow race condition where quantity becomes -1 without throwing out-of-stock validation.

title: Tax computation fails when customer address postal code is missing
description: Orders with international addresses lacking postal codes throw UnhandledTaxCalculationException and abort the checkout process completely.

title: Button alignment broken on mobile viewports under 375px
description: On iPhone SE screen widths, the submit and cancel buttons overlap with the bottom navigation bar and become partially unclickable.

title: Dark mode theme causes unreadable black text on dark background
description: In dashboard analytics tables, table cell typography retains hardcoded color #1a1a1a instead of switching to light text token in dark theme.

title: Modal dialog does not close when clicking backdrop overlay
description: Clicking outside the user profile edit modal does not trigger close event, forcing users to manually locate the small X icon.

title: Dropdown menu clipped by parent overflow container
description: The organization selector dropdown menu gets cut off by the top navigation bar overflow-hidden CSS property, hiding items 4 to 10.

title: Font size mismatch between billing and shipping address forms
description: Billing form header uses 16px Inter Semibold while shipping form header renders at 24px Roboto Bold creating jarring visual inconsistency.

title: Tooltip flickers continuously on mouse hover over metrics card
description: CSS hover animation conflicts with JavaScript mouseenter listener, causing the metric card info tooltip to flicker rapidly.

title: Form validation error badge displays behind the input field
description: The z-index of the red error tooltip is lower than the input border shadow, rendering the validation warning invisible to users.

title: Spinner icon does not disappear after table data finishes loading
description: Loading state indicator remains spinning indefinitely in the corner of the user management table even after REST request returns 200 OK.

title: Dashboard load time exceeds 15 seconds due to unindexed query
description: Loading the main analytics page executes multiple unindexed full-table scans across 2 million transaction records, causing 15s delay.

title: Memory leak in background report generator worker process
description: The PDF export worker process fails to dispose of ReportLab canvas objects, causing worker RAM to climb from 200MB to 4GB until OOM crash.

title: High CPU utilization caused by unoptimized regex in log parser
description: A catastrophic backtracking regex used to parse user-agent strings locks CPU cores at 100% when encountering malformed client strings.

title: N+1 database query problem in payment history listing
description: Fetching 50 customer payment records triggers 51 individual SQL select queries to resolve user billing addresses instead of using a JOIN.

title: Database connection pool exhaustion under moderate load
description: Database connection pool is limited to 5 connections with no connection timeout, causing worker threads to hang indefinitely on peak traffic.

title: Uncompressed asset payloads increase initial page load by 8MB
description: Bundle delivery serves unminified JS libraries and uncompressed high-resolution PNG images, causing severe latency on 3G cellular connections.

title: Excessive re-rendering of entire dashboard tree on filter change
description: Changing date range dropdown triggers full re-render of 12 distinct chart widgets rather than updating data points in place.

title: Payment gateway webhook timeout causes duplicate billing
description: Webhook endpoint response time exceeds Stripe 10-second timeout, prompting Stripe to retry notification and charge customer card twice.

title: WebSocket connection drops intermittently every 60 seconds
description: Heartbeat ping interval is missing from WebSocket server configuration, causing AWS ALB reverse proxy to terminate idle socket connections.

title: DNS resolution failure when contacting third-party SMS provider
description: Intermittent DNS SERVFAIL responses from internal resolver cause user phone verification SMS delivery to fail with ConnectionRefused.

title: TCP connection reset by peer during large file upload
description: Large customer document uploads over 50MB fail halfway through with ECONNRESET due to aggressive upstream nginx client_body_timeout.

title: SSL handshake failure when connecting to legacy payment API
description: Client TLS configuration enforces TLS 1.3 only, but legacy merchant bank API server only supports TLS 1.2, resulting in handshake failure.

title: HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout on bulk user CSV import endpoint
description: Importing over 1000 users in a single synchronous HTTP POST times out at load balancer proxy before processing completes.

title: Network socket leak in third-party currency exchange client
description: HTTP connection pooling client fails to close stale sockets, leaving hundreds of TCP connections in CLOSE_WAIT state until port exhaustion.

title: API gateway drops authorization header on cross-domain redirect
description: When API gateway performs 302 redirect from auth domain to resource domain, the Bearer token header is stripped by the HTTP client.

title: Intermittent packet loss between database replica and primary
description: Replication lag spikes above 300 seconds due to network interface errors on database replica host, causing stale read queries.

title: Third-party license key expired in PDF generation module
description: Commercial PDF library throws InvalidLicenseKeyException during automated weekly digest creation, causing background job crash.

title: Typo in welcome email template text string
description: Registration confirmation email reads 'Thank you for siging up' instead of 'Thank you for signing up' in footer paragraph.

title: Missing translation keys for French locale in privacy policy
description: Switching system language to French displays raw key string 'i18n.privacy.legal_notice' instead of localized French legal paragraph.

title: Deprecation warning in Python cryptography dependency
description: Application startup outputs CryptographyDeprecationWarning regarding TripleDES cipher in legacy payment parser module.

title: Raw SQL error message exposed to user on bad login query
description: Entering special characters in login form outputs internal SQLite syntax error stack trace directly to the client browser UI.

title: Unencrypted HTTP traffic accepted on password change route
description: Password change endpoint accepts plaintext HTTP connections instead of enforcing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) and HTTPS redirection.

title: Missing CSRF token validation on money transfer POST request
description: The POST /transfers/send form does not generate or validate Anti-CSRF synchronization tokens, allowing cross-site state manipulation.

title: Stored XSS in user profile comment section
description: User comments submitted with are stored verbatim in database and rendered unescaped on public dashboard.

title: Weak password policy permits single character passwords
description: Registration form accepts 1-character password 'a' with no complexity or length requirements, leaving accounts vulnerable to guessing.

title: API key leaked in client-side JavaScript bundle
description: Production webpack bundle includes private Stripe secret key sk_live_... embedded inside a compiled frontend helper file.

title: Privilege escalation via altered role parameter in profile update
description: Sending JSON payload {'role': 'admin'} to PUT /api/user/profile elevates standard user privileges to administrator without authorization.

title: Timing attack vulnerability in password comparison routine
description: Authentication service uses standard string equality operator == instead of constant-time comparison, leaking password prefix lengths.

title: User session fixation upon authentication
description: Session cookie ID is not regenerated upon successful login, allowing attacker to fixate a session ID before victim authenticates.

title: SSRF vulnerability in URL preview generator service
description: Dashboard bookmark preview accepts internal addresses like http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/, exposing cloud infrastructure metadata.

title: XML External Entity (XXE) injection in invoice parser
description: Invoice XML upload parser enables external entity resolution, allowing attackers to read internal server files via file:/// URI handlers.

title: Sensitive user data cached by public proxy servers
description: Cache-Control header is omitted from sensitive user profile API responses, allowing intermediate CDN and proxy servers to cache PII data.

title: Logic flaw allows bypassing OTP verification during password reset
description: Submitting an empty OTP code parameter otp='' bypasses verification check due to loose equality check in PHP backend.

title: Calculation error in employee overtime hours
description: Payroll logic calculates overtime as hours * 1.0 instead of hours * 1.5 when pay period spans across two calendar months.

title: Incorrect date format parsing causes registration failure on leap day
description: Registration form parses date of birth with strict 28-day February limit, rejecting valid February 29th leap year birthdates.

title: Cart item count desynchronized when multiple items removed
description: Clicking remove on two cart items in rapid succession results in stale frontend state displaying incorrect item badge count.

title: Order total calculates negative shipping fee on remote locations
description: Formula subtracts regional promo code from shipping rate without minimum zero floor, leading to negative shipping charges.

title: User account locked prematurely after 1 failed login attempt
description: Account lockout threshold is configured to 1 attempt instead of policy specification of 5 attempts, locking valid users out.

title: Refund status displays Approved even when payment gateway rejects charge
description: Order history table sets status to 'Refunded' immediately upon button click before receiving gateway approval response.

title: Incorrect permissions granted on team invitation acceptance
description: Inviting user as Viewer automatically assigns Admin role due to swapped enum index constants in TeamMemberService.

title: Table header columns misaligned with body rows in Chrome
description: On Google Chrome 124, data table headers do not align with data columns due to display: flex table styling glitch.

title: Logo image distorted on high DPI retina displays
description: Brand logo image tag lacks width/height attributes and vector SVG fallback, appearing pixelated and blurry on 4K monitors.

title: Calendar date picker popup positioned outside visible screen
description: Date picker popup renders with negative left CSS offset when input field is located near right edge of the viewport.

title: Password visibility eye toggle icon missing from login screen
description: User cannot reveal entered password on login screen because the eye toggle icon SVG is missing from the assets directory.

title: Radio buttons cannot be deselected or toggled via keyboard
description: Survey radio buttons lack proper tabIndex and aria-checked attributes, breaking accessibility compliance for screen readers.

title: Success alert banner covers the top navigation links
description: Green success banner positioned with fixed z-index 9999 blocks clicking the profile dropdown and navigation menu.

title: Database query hangs indefinitely due to missing table lock timeout
description: Lock escalation on transactions table during nightly batch reconciliation blocks all incoming checkout queries.

title: Slow page load due to synchronous third-party analytics script
description: Google Tag Manager script tag loaded synchronously in HTML head blocks page parsing and rendering for 4.2 seconds on slow networks.

title: Massive heap allocation during CSV export of 500k rows
description: Exporting audit logs streams entire database table into memory array at once, triggering Java OutOfMemoryError crash.

title: Unindexed foreign key on user_id causes slow delete operations
description: Deleting an inactive user triggers full table scan across 10 million audit log records, taking over 45 seconds to complete.

title: Excessive HTTP requests on autocomplete input
description: Search autocomplete component sends an API request on every single keystroke without debounce or throttle delay.

title: High latency on user login due to excessive bcrypt work factor
description: Bcrypt salt rounds configured to 18 causes password hashing to consume 12 seconds of CPU time per login request.

title: Payment webhook requests fail with 502 Bad Gateway
description: Uwsgi application server workers run out of execution threads, causing nginx reverse proxy to return 502 Bad Gateway to payment provider.

title: CORS header missing on REST API preflight OPTIONS request
description: Browser blocks API calls from mobile web app because the server fails to return Access-Control-Allow-Methods on OPTIONS preflight.

title: Connection pool exhausted when calling SMS verification gateway
description: HTTP client to Twilio SMS API does not close connections on socket timeout, quickly saturating outgoing connection pool.

title: Database read replica replication lag causes 404 on immediate read
description: Writing new user account to primary database and immediately reading from lagged replica returns 404 User Not Found.

title: SSL certificate expired on payment gateway sandbox webhook
description: Sandbox webhook endpoint rejected by payment provider because the staging SSL certificate expired yesterday.

title: OAuth2 callback fails with invalid redirect_uri error
description: Google OAuth login redirects to http instead of https on production server, failing OAuth provider whitelist check.

title: API returns HTTP 500 error when receiving IPv6 client address
description: IP geolocation utility crashes with ValueError when passed IPv6 address format fe80::1 instead of standard IPv4.

title: Documentation link in dashboard help menu returns 404
description: Clicking 'Getting Started Guide' in the help dropdown navigates to outdated URL /docs/v1/start which returns 404 Not Found.

title: Copyright year in footer displays 2022 instead of current year
description: Static HTML footer contains hardcoded copyright year 2022 instead of dynamic JavaScript or server-side template year.

title: Misspelled error message in registration form validation
description: When password is too short, error message reads 'Passwrod must be at least 8 characters long' with noticeable typo.

title: Automated cleanup cron job fails to run due to missing executable bit
description: Nightly database backup script /etc/cron.daily/backup.sh lacks chmod +x executable permissions, preventing execution.

title: Release notes modal contains raw markdown syntax
description: Dashboard release notes modal renders raw markdown headers ### and asterisks instead of parsing HTML formatting.

title: JWT token algorithm 'none' allowed by authentication middleware
description: JWT verification library configured with algorithms=['HS256', 'none'], allowing forged tokens signed with algorithm 'none'.

title: SQL injection in report sorting parameter
description: Dashboard parameter sort_by is directly concatenated into SQL query: ORDER BY ' + sort_by, permitting UNION-based SQL injection.

title: Cross-Site Scripting via SVG file upload
description: Uploaded SVG avatar containing embedded <script> tags executes JavaScript when viewed directly in browser.

title: Database credentials exposed in public git repository
description: Database username and root password found committed to repository in public config.json file.

title: Price tampering vulnerability in checkout API
description: API accepts client-provided unit_price parameter in POST /orders/create without re-verifying price against catalog database.

title: Account enumeration via differing password reset error messages
description: Submitting password reset displays 'User not found' for invalid emails and 'Email sent' for valid emails, enabling user enumeration.

title: Race condition in referral bonus credit calculation
description: Redeeming referral code simultaneously from two threads credits the $20 referral bonus twice to both user wallets.

title: Search index desynchronized after bulk database update
description: Direct SQL update of product inventory does not trigger Elasticsearch re-index hook, leaving search results showing stale items.
